title: 第0001章 灵气炸穿太阳系系统激活第002章 星门开启天元星航线正式通航
slug: 全民修仙之系统上交囯家
content_zh:
华纪53年，深秋。
华夏联盟深空监测站的红色警报，在同一秒响彻全球所有军事基地。
不是演习。
木星轨道外，一道横跨三百万公里的紫色光墙，正以光速碾压而来。所过之处，所有探测器集体过载，屏幕上只剩下刺目的白光。
“能量峰值无法计算！不是电磁波，不是辐射——是全新的能量形态！”
“它在改写物理规则！太阳系的基本常数正在变化！”
指挥中心一片死寂。所有人都盯着那道吞噬一切的紫光，浑身冰冷。
这不是自然现象。
这是某种文明的宣战书。
江南某军事基地，张德华猛地抬头。一股温暖而庞大的能量穿透墙壁，涌入他的四肢百骸。
【叮！文明升级系统绑定成功！】
冰冷的机械音在脑海中炸响。
【宿主：张德华，华夏联盟陆军少校】
【当前文明等级：2.0级恒星文明】
【检测到入侵文明：天元修仙文明，等级3.8级星系文明】
【警告：修仙文明先遣队将在900天后抵达太阳系。届时，人类文明将被彻底征服或毁灭】
【紧急任务：900天内将华夏文明提升至2.2级，解锁灵能武器体系】
【任务奖励：灵能-电能转化装置全套设计图】
张德华的瞳孔骤然收缩。
90天。

一个能炸穿太阳系物理规则的文明，三个月后就要来灭族。
他没有丝毫犹豫，转身冲向指挥部。
六小时后，华夏联盟最高紧急会议。
当张德华掌心亮起那缕淡金色的灵气，当系统导出的修仙文明战力数据投射在大屏幕上，所有高层同时站起。
“元婴修士，全力一击等于10万吨***当量。”
“化神修士，可徒手撕裂大陆板块。”
“而天元星，至少有十位化神。”
统帅沉默了三秒，猛地拍桌：“启动最高战时状态！全国工业体系向灵能方向转产！张德华，我给你最高权限，要人给人，要物给物！”
“是！”
张德华立正敬礼。
窗外，紫色的极光铺满了整个夜空。
没有人知道，这一夜之后，人类文明的历史，将被彻底改写。
会议结束的第二天，三架凌霄-20隐身战机从海南基地升空，以35马赫的速度冲破大气层。
目标：月球背面，那道刚刚出现的紫色空间门。
“报告指挥官，已抵达空间门入口。”
“进入。保持电磁静默，被动侦测。”
张德华坐在深空指挥中心，盯着屏幕上的实时画面。
战机穿过空间门的瞬间，所有人都倒吸一口凉气。
眼前是一颗翠绿色的星球。
大陆被参天古木覆盖，海洋泛着碧蓝色的灵光。十几座浮空岛屿悬在万米高空，上面宫殿林立，灵光冲天。

更恐怖的是——
成千上万的修士，正踩着飞剑、葫芦、灵禽，在天空中自由穿梭。有人抬手放出火龙，有人挥手降下冰雨，法术碰撞的光芒照亮了半个天空。
content_en:
It was late autumn in the 53rd year of the Chinese Era.
The red alert from the Chinese Alliance Deep Space Monitoring Station sounded throughout all military bases around the world at the same second.
Not a drill.
Outside the orbit of Jupiter, a purple wall of light spanning three million kilometers is crushing at the speed of light. Wherever it passed, all the detectors were collectively overloaded, leaving only dazzling white light on the screen.
"The energy peak cannot be calculated! It's not electromagnetic waves, it's not radiation - it's a brand new energy form!"
"It's rewriting the rules of physics! The basic constants of the solar system are changing!"
There was dead silence in the command center. Everyone was staring at the purple light that swallowed everything, and their whole bodies were cold.
This is not a natural phenomenon.
This is a kind of declaration of war for civilization.
At a military base in the south of the Yangtze River, Zhang Dehua suddenly looked up. A warm and huge energy penetrated the wall and poured into his limbs.
【bite! The civilization upgrade system is successfully bound! 】
A cold mechanical sound exploded in my mind.
[Host: Zhang Dehua, Major of the Chinese Alliance Army]
[Current civilization level: Level 2.0 stellar civilization]
[Invading civilization detected: Tianyuan Xiuxian Civilization, level 3.8 galaxy civilization]
[Warning: The advance team of the immortal civilization will arrive in the solar system in 900 days. By then, human civilization will be completely conquered or destroyed]
[Emergency mission: Upgrade Chinese civilization to level 2.2 within 900 days and unlock the psychic weapon system]
[Task reward: A complete set of design drawings of the psychic-electrical energy conversion device]
Zhang Dehua's pupils suddenly shrank.
90 days.
A civilization that can explode the physical rules of the solar system will be exterminated in three months.
Without any hesitation, he turned around and rushed towards the headquarters.
Six hours later, the Chinese Alliance held its highest emergency meeting.
When the light golden aura lit up in Zhang Dehua's palm, and when the combat power data of the immortal civilization exported by the system was projected on the big screen, all the senior officials stood up at the same time.
"Monk Nascent Soul, one full blow is equivalent to 100,000 tons of gunpowder."
"A monk who transforms into gods can tear apart continental plates with his bare hands."
"As for Tianyuan Star, there are at least ten transformed gods."
The commander was silent for three seconds, then slammed the table: "Activate the highest wartime state! Convert the national industrial system to the direction of spiritual energy! Zhang Dehua, I give you the highest authority. If you want people, give people things, and if you want things, give things!"
"Yes!"
Zhang Dehua stood at attention and saluted.
Outside the window, the purple aurora filled the entire night sky.
No one knows that after this night, the history of human civilization will be completely rewritten.
The day after the meeting, three Lingxiao-20 stealth fighters took off from the Hainan base and broke through the atmosphere at a speed of Mach 35.
Target: The purple space gate that just appeared on the back of the moon.
"Report to Commander, we have arrived at the entrance to the space gate."
"Enter. Maintain electromagnetic silence and passive detection."
Zhang Dehua sat in the deep space command center and stared at the real-time picture on the screen.
The moment the fighter plane passed through the space door, everyone gasped.
In front of you is an emerald green planet.
The continent is covered with towering ancient trees, and the ocean is glowing with azure aura. More than a dozen floating islands are suspended 10,000 meters high in the sky, with palaces standing on them and auras soaring into the sky.
What’s even more terrifying is——
Thousands of monks are flying freely through the sky on flying swords, gourds, and spiritual birds. Someone raised his hand to release the fire dragon, someone waved his hand to bring down icy rain, and the light from the collision of spells illuminated half of the sky.
